entries.t: BUILD
entries.d: Your opportunity scores high across value dimensions. You have a unique data or domain advantage that makes building in-house the optimal strategy.

entries.t: BUY / PARTNER
entries.d: The opportunity is real but you lack the unique data moat or in-house capability to justify building. A vendor solution or strategic partnership offers faster time-to-value.

entries.t: EXPERIMENT
entries.d: The opportunity shows potential but key assumptions remain unvalidated. Run a time-boxed experiment to de-risk before committing significant resources.

entries.t: KILL
entries.d: The opportunity does not justify AI investment at this time. The problem may be better solved with non-AI approaches, or the organizational readiness isn't there yet.
